transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, August 1. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Neeraj Chopra takes silver, Yashvir wins bronze as India secure two medals in javelin at CWG. Neeraj, the 28-year-old Tokyo Olympic champion, was not at his best in difficult weather but still managed a season-best throw of 85.83m in his second attempt to finish second. PM Modi: I forgive those who abused me and my mom, our job to guide them. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will forgive young protesters accused of abuse. He stated these misguided children need guidance and correction, not punishment. The Prime Minister believes punishing them will not change circumstances effectively. Mistakes made at a young age present an opportunity for correction and societal acceptance. 'Dhurandhar' gangster's brother shot in Karachi. Zubair Baloch, brother of jailed gangster Uzair Baloch, was critically wounded in a drive-by shooting. Two masked assailants on a motorcycle opened fire, striking him in the chest and abdomen. Zubair was rushed to Civil Hospital Karachi for emergency surgery after the attack. Police are investigating personal enmity and potential gang war resurgence as motives. Amid opposition protest, Lok Sabha passes births and deaths bill. The Lok Sabha passed the Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Bill, 2026, without any debate. Opposition members disrupted Rajya Sabha proceedings, preventing any business from being transacted. The bill aims to make delayed registrations of births and deaths more stringent. Congress and SP MPs raised issues concerning police actions and alleged temple donation theft. Ethanol kept petrol prices lower: Government. Ethanol blending saved consumers nearly thirty rupees per litre on petrol. Global crude prices reached one hundred thirty-five dollars a barrel recently. The government kept fuel prices unchanged for seventy-five days initially. E20 petrol now costs one hundred two rupees per litre in Delhi. When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons. Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. Tahir Hussain gets life for IB staffer's killing in 2020 riots. A Delhi court sentenced former AAP councillor Tahir Hussain and four others to life imprisonment. They were convicted for the murder of Intelligence Bureau staffer Ankit Sharma. The court found Sharma was lynched solely on account of his religion during the 2020 riots. While the prosecution sought the death penalty, it was declined by the judge. 16.4 percent deleted in Haryana draft roll; 10.8 percent in Andhra Pradesh. Draft voter rolls in Haryana and Andhra Pradesh reveal significant exclusions. Over sixteen percent of Haryana's electorate and over ten percent in Andhra were removed. Reasons cited include deaths, permanent shifts, and multiple registrations. However, genuine voters can still be added during the claims period. Gold loans jump 94 percent y-o-y, fuel bank credit growth in Q1. Gold loans fueled a significant acceleration in bank credit during Q1FY27. This segment expanded by 93.8 percent year on year, adding substantial value. Overall bank credit also saw robust growth, crossing a significant milestone. Credit to industry recorded its highest first-quarter expansion in recent years. Michigan woman sues Toll Brothers over access to her 19-acre property. A woman from Michigan has initiated legal action against Toll Brothers concerning their wastewater management and access rights. Her property, undeveloped, is situated between two upcoming luxury housing estates. The lawsuit alleges that the developers have disregarded her property rights and neglected environmental regulations. She aims to reinstate her access easement and challenge the site plan approvals. US plans $100K fee on foreign students: What it means for engineers. The US government is reportedly considering a $100,000 fee for foreign students seeking post-graduation work. This proposed fee targets the Optional Practical Training program, impacting many international graduates. This follows a significant H-1B visa fee hike imposed on sponsoring companies last year. Indian engineers, who dominate H-1B approvals, face increased challenges in securing US careers.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. MP's 12,000 Jan Shikshaks Under Scanner For Neglecting Academic Mentoring Role. Nearly 12,000 Jan Shikshaks in Madhya Pradesh are under scrutiny for allegedly neglecting their primary role of mentoring teachers and improving classroom learning. Bhopal Municipal Corporation To Begin Sealing Illegal Commercial Units In Residential Areas From Today. The Bhopal Municipal Corporation will begin sealing illegal commercial establishments operating from residential properties on Saturday after a 24-hour ultimatum expired. Retires; He Got Title Of 'Dewas Ka Bhagirath'. 1996-batch IAS officer Umakant Umrao retired on Friday after a distinguished career. Cybercriminals Duped Five Bhopal Residents Of rupees 32 Lakh Across Multiple Scams. Cybercriminals allegedly cheated five people of over rupees 32 lakh in separate frauds across Bhopal. Indore Administration Clears rupees 5.5 Crore Government Land, Demolishes Illegal Colony Structures. The Indore district administration reclaimed government land worth rupees 5.5 crore during anti-encroachment drives in Kanadiya and Bicholi Hapsi on Friday. Indore Mayor Assures Relief To Industries On New Fire Safety Rules. Indore Mayor Pushyamitra Bhargav assured industrialists that no harsh action would be taken while implementing new fire safety rules. Madhya Pradesh Man Haplessly Watches Son Die In Ambulance After Oxygen Exhausts; Probe Ordered. Rain reign continues in Bhopal, IMD warns of thunderstorm. Garments shop gutted in fire in Bhopal; none hurt. Bhopal gas tragedy survivors' groups allege sewage-contaminated water supply; civic body denies claim. 70 percent water samples near abandoned Union Carbide factory in Bhopal found contaminated India News. Flat tyre costs Morena businessman rupees 10 lakh. Brother, sister drown in well while spraying pesticides in MP. MP Information Commission summons Kuno cheetah project director in RTI cases. CM's first yatra under 'CM Jan Vishwas Abhiyan' at Chhindwara. Woman friend detained from Bhopal in Indore property dealer's death case. CMHO office staffer held taking rupees 10,000 bribe for hospital job in MP. Infant Death In Madhya Pradesh: 'Distressed Mother' Arrested For Drowning 4-Day-Old Daughter.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Yen's Intervention Rally Stalls as Traders Brace for More Action. The yen swung between gains and losses after its intervention-driven rally stalled, spurring speculation that Japanese authorities could step into the market again. Hedge Funds Add Bullish Bets on Oil at Fastest Pace Since March. Hedge funds boosted bullish wagers on US oil at the fastest pace since March as supply disruptions from Iran to the Red and Black Seas are set to once again boost demand for American crude. US wheat falls on technical trading. GLOBAL-GRAINS/ (UPDATE 3):GRAINS TSX ends lower as gold falls, posts fourth straight monthly gain. CANADA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 2):CANADA STOCKS-TSX ends lower as gold falls, p Oil Posts Biggest Monthly Jump Since March as Iran War Simmers. Oil posted its biggest monthly gain since March as traders grappled with simmering global conflicts and threats to supply from the Persian Gulf to the Black Sea. Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold drops $84, silver slips $2 as US dollar rebounds. Gold and silver prices fell on 31 July amid a stronger US dollar and hawkish Federal Reserve comments. Gold lost $84 per ounce but remained 1.5 percent higher for July, while silver declined to $57.22, tracking a 4 percent drop for the month. Apple set to lose $500 billion in value: Can Nvidia reclaim the world's most valuable company crown?. Apple shares fell nearly 10 percent after a forecast revealed component shortages due to AI data centre demand, raising concerns over its market value. CEO Tim Cook noted significant supply chain issues as investors worried about weak service growth despite strong iPhone sales amid rising prices. Bharat Electronics shares to be in focus on Monday as company secures rupees 847 crore order. Bharat Electronics Ltd. (BEL) announced a new order worth rupees 847 crore, prompting investor interest. This follows a previous rupees 572 crore order in July and a significant rupees 1,081 crore order in June. Despite recent orders, BEL shares faced a decline in 2026. SIR 3.0 draft rolls: Over 1 crore names deleted. More than 1.12 crore names have been deleted from electoral rolls across ten states and Union Territories. Bloomberg again defers decision on including Indian government bonds in Global Aggregate Index. Global investors acknowledge India's progress on market access but want recent operational reforms to prove themselves in everyday trading before sovereign bonds join the Bloomberg Global Aggregate Index. 'Abuses never solve anything': PM Modi. Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a video message urging society to guide young protesters. Jio Financial Services declares record date to finalise eligible shareholders for FY26 final dividend. Jio Financial Services has set August 10 as the record date for a final dividend of rupees 0.60 per equity share for FY 2025-26. Investors must buy before this date to qualify. The company reported a 156 percent YoY profit increase to rupees 830 crore for Q2 2026. Neeraj Chopra settles for silver at CWG 2026. Neeraj Chopra secured silver and Yashvir Singh claimed bronze in the javelin throw. Wall Street surges as Amazon rallies on strong earnings, chip stocks jump on optimism about AI returns. At 9:47 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.16 percent , the S and P 500 gained 0.12 percent , the Nasdaq Composite gained 0.34 percent Tata Steel eyes more value, not just volume. Tata Steel executives emphasize value-added products over mere production capacity. Amazon shares surge 11 percent after earnings while Apple slipped 8 percent in the US markets. Shares of Amazon surged 11 percent after growth in its cloud, AI and chips divisions; while Apple shares fell 8 percent after the company's forecast disappointed investors. Apple's Mac has its biggest-ever quarter in India. Apple achieved record revenue in India during the June quarter. Pulse of the Street: foreign flows, IT rebound power best week in four months. IT stocks spearheaded the rally, with the BSE IT gaining 6.5 percent during the week. TPG, Permira lead rupees 11,000 cr Cloudnine deal race. TPG Capital and Permira are leading contenders for a significant minority stake in Cloudnine. Exxon Mobil Q2 profit more than doubles to $14.5 billion as higher energy prices boost earnings. Exxon Mobil reported a 105 percent YoY increase in Q2 net profit to $14.53 billion, with revenue rising 42 percent to $116.02 billion. Higher oil prices and record production in the Permian Basin and diesel output contributed to strong earnings, despite market disruptions. Where Israel and Hamas stand on Gaza roadmap. President Donald Trump announced a Gaza war breakthrough agreement for Hamas disarmament. US stock market today: S and P 500, Nasdaq futures extend rally on strong tech earnings; Amazon up 13 percent. Technology stocks saw a rebound driven by strong earnings, but July is set for a 7 percent decline for Nasdaq-100. Oil prices climbed amid Middle East tensions, benefiting Exxon and Chevron, which reported substantial profit increases. Investor sentiment remains cautious due to geopolitical instability. Top 5 tech and startup stories of the day. Zepto has decided to pause its IPO amid pricing concerns. Maruti Suzuki Q1 Results: Net profit drops 9 percent as margin pressure offsets revenue growth; post-record sales. Maruti Suzuki reported a 9.1 percent YoY decline in profit to rupees 3,446.9 crore despite a 35.9 percent increase in revenue to rupees 52,469 crore. Higher input costs and expenses pressured profitability, leading to a price hike of up to rupees 30,000 across its vehicle range. Maruti's rupees 561 cr fuel play, cost woes and more. Maruti Suzuki India is investing rupees 561 crore in four compressed biogas manufacturing projects. ITC Q1 results: Consolidated profit drops 16 percent YoY to rupees 4,394 crore; cigarettes revenue surges 81 percent YoY. ITC Q1 results: ITC reported a 16.2 percent year-on-year drop in its consolidated profit to rupees 4,394.13 crore for Q1FY27. Revenue from operations for the quarter rose 27.6 percent YoY and 23.9 percent QoQ to rupees 29,523.30 crore. Italy suspends Schengen pact with Spain. Italy has suspended Schengen border-free travel with Spain for one month.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. ITR income tax filing deadline extension date July 31 2026: Has due date been moved to August?. The July 31, 2026, income tax return filing deadline remains unchanged for many taxpayers. Those who missed this date must now file a belated return and pay a late fee. Taxpayers with business income and those requiring a tax audit have different filing deadlines. The due date for business income without audit is August 31, 2026. Lakshmi Yojana in Delhi: What are the two options for receiving monthly rupees 2500 assistance? Eligibility, norms and more. The Delhi government approved the Lakshmi Yojana, allowing eligible women aged 21-60 to receive rupees 2,500 monthly. An online application portal will launch on August 1, with the first payment expected around Raksha Bandhan. Pensionbazaar strengthens its corporate NPS platform to simplify retirement planning. Pensionbazaar has improved its Corporate National Pension System offering. This aims to make retirement planning more accessible and seamless for employees. The platform simplifies onboarding, contribution management, and account servicing for employers. Employees can now digitally manage their retirement corpus and track progress easily. EPFO: Account blocked, unable to access passbook, KYC pending? Here's a look at the common issues and how to fix them. EPFO members who find their account blocked, can't remember their UAN password, are unable to access their passbook or have KYC pending can check how to fix issues using the portal or Umang app. DA hike for June 2026: Central government employees likely to get 63 percent dearness allowance after hike. DA hike: Central government employees anticipate a 3 percent dearness allowance increase. This expectation arises from the latest AICPI-IW reading for June 2026. The calculation suggests a potential 63 percent overall dearness allowance for employees. This hike will impact salaries across various pay levels under the 7th Pay Commission. The patience payoff: How a rupees 30,000 monthly SIP swells into rupees 50 lakh by 2034. The initial years of SIP investing often require considerable patience. Even with disciplined monthly contributions, many investors feel disappointed as their portfolio appears to grow slowly due to market volatility and a relatively small investment base PM Kisan instalment date: Check eligibility, beneficiary status and how to complete e-KYC. PM Kisan 24th instalment: The PM Kisan scheme provides annual income support to eligible farmer families. The 24th instalment is anticipated in October 2026, following the June 2026 disbursement. Farmers can verify their beneficiary status online using Aadhaar or account numbers. Annapurna Yojana: No money in bank account yet? Check what to do if your application gets rejected. Many women in West Bengal applied for the Annapurna Yojana but haven't received financial aid. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari set a payment deadline for August while verification continues. Planning to invest over rupees 10 lakh in fixed deposits? Here are 4 benefits of splitting your money across multiple FDs. Investors face a choice between single and multiple fixed deposits for large sums. Splitting deposits offers better liquidity and increased insurance coverage. FD laddering allows reinvestment at prevailing interest rates for potential gains. Managing multiple FDs requires more effort and careful tracking of renewals. 8th pay commission announces state visit to Chandigarh in September 2026 , Check dates, other details. The 8th pay commission has announced its official three-day state visit to the union territory of Chandigarh in September. It will hold meetings with employee unions and stakeholders from Chandigarh, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh and Punjab. DA hike: Second dearness allowance increase to come during Diwali this year? Here's what past announcements indicate. DA hike: Central government employees and pensioners are expecting a second increase in dearness allowance this year, sometime in the second half, as a "Diwali gift" during the festive season. Wealth wisdom: "If I had more money, I would have a better plan. My mentor responded ..." said author of '7 Strategies For Wealth and Happiness' - check this smart budgeting rule so you have more money. Do you also believe that having more would mean that you will have a better plan? Well, if you do, you might be wrong. 'Business philosopher' Jim Rohn's 70/30 money rule explains why financial planning matters more than income. Read on to know budgeting rules to manage your money smarter. rupees 1.1 trillion blind spot: How ignoring employee health is costing Indian businesses. The largest hidden cost is presenteeism, where employees show up to work but cannot perform at their full capacity. This phenomenon accounts for rupees 51,000 crore of the total annual cost to employers. No input tax credit for the innocent buyer after paying GST? Supreme Court settles who bears the cost when a supplier defaults. The Supreme Court affirmed Gujarat High Court's decision on CGST Act Section 16(2)(c). This ruling validates the provision requiring tax payment by suppliers for buyer's credit. Honest businesses now face stricter compliance requirements for input tax credit. The court's reasoned dismissal binds all lower courts and authorities across India. Health insurance: Co-payment versus deductible explained. Which one should you choose?. Having a clear understanding of co-payments and deductibles in health insurance can help policyholders estimate out-of-pocket costs, compare plans, and avoid claim surprises. This guide explains how both clauses work, their impact on premiums, and how to choose the right policy. ESOP tax rules for ITR filing: Know when salary tax and capital gains apply to avoid costly reporting mistakes. ESOP taxation can arise at two stages, when shares are exercised and when they are sold. Here's how salary income, capital gains, fair market value and record-keeping affect ITR filing for AY 2026-27, and how to avoid these common tax reporting mistakes. Reporting perquisite as capital gain in ITR by mistake resulted in rupees 6.63 crore penalty for a salaried employee; ITAT Mumbai granted him relief for this reason. rupees 6.63 crore penalty imposed on salaried employee for reporting perquisite as capital gains in ITR; ITAT Mumbai grants relief, says salaried employees may not be well versed in complex tax provisions. Read the story to know the full details. Belated versus updated return: Which should you file if you miss the 31 July income tax return deadline?. Taxpayers who fail to file their returns within the original due date still have two other options to complete the process. Here's how belated and updated return work and which one you should choose if you end up missing the July 31 deadline. 8th Pay Commission salary calculator: How gross salary of central government employees may double in 7 years at high annual increment rate, DA merger with basic pay. Fitment factor in 8th Pay Commission: Employee groups recommend increasing annual increments and merging dearness allowance with basic pay. This move aims to accelerate salary growth for government employees and pensioners. A higher increment rate and DA merger could potentially double gross salaries within seven years. Various organizations have submitted specific proposals regarding increment percentages and DA merger thresholds. rupees 15 lakh income, different tax liabilities: Why salaried middle class ends up paying highest tax. India's income tax system is progressive - higher incomes are taxed at higher rates. However, the final tax liability depends not just on how much a person earns, but also on how that income is earned. ITR filing deadline extension: Will Income Tax Department extend July 31 ITR filing due date? Here's what chartered accountants believe. ITR filing deadline: Nearly 5.44 crore taxpayers filed income tax returns for AY 2026-27 by July 30. Experts suggest the July 31 deadline extension for income tax returns is unlikely. The e-filing portal has been functioning smoothly with no widespread technical issues reported. Taxpayers should file their returns by the July 31 deadline to avoid penalties. Personal accident cover versus standalone term insurance: Which is best fit and gives better value for money?. Personal accident cover and standalone term insurance provide financial protection but serve different purposes. Let's deep dive into similarities and differences between the two insurance policies. Filed your ITR in the last hour? These 5 mistakes can trigger a defective return notice. As the 31 July ITR filing deadline approaches, taxpayers should review their returns to avoid errors that may lead to a defective return notice from the income tax department. Here are 5 mistakes can trigger a defective return notice. August 2026 financial changes: ITR filing deadline, Axis Bank card rules, Kotak DCC fee hike; check key dates. August 2026 brings several important financial changes that could impact taxpayers and bank customers.
